title: Adopt SpecSync 5.0.1 and Trust 1.0.0 governance
no_spec_change_rationale: This migration adds governance and an active canonical description of existing behavior; it does not change the Music library's behavior or public API.
acceptance_criteria: SpecSync 5.0.1 documents every parsed export and all 25 source files/3,349 LOC at 100%; all four agents report installed; native build and all 110 tests pass; Trust passes; macOS, Ubuntu, CodeQL, DocC, release, and public API boundaries remain preserved.
